definitions.shell: D_min = r_v / sin(theta_v), D_max = R_max - r_v, r_v = 0.5 a_att tau_v^2 (delta = 0)
definitions.aim_point: c = p_att + v_att tau_v (witness-sphere center; independent of cv/ma aim)
definitions.shell_pass: an episode with at least one window tick whose |c - p_fin| is in [D_min, D_max]
definitions.window: robust ticks of that episode under variant v; pooled median over shell-passing episodes of all 4 slots
definitions.prediction: N_pred = N_inf (1 - rho0(theta_v)/rho_v)+, N_inf = R_max/(V dt), rho0 = sec + tan, rho*(theta) = rho0/(1 - 4 dt V/R_max)

report: classification agreement (median >= 4 vs rho_v >= rho*(theta_v)) over 12 variants
